name: NVDA Donchian Breakout
description: Long-only Donchian breakout on NVDA with 200-day SMA trend filter. Entry: close breaks above prior bar's 20-day Donchian upper band AND close is above the 200-day SMA. Exit: close breaks below prior bar's 10-day Donchian lower band. Position sizing: 100% of equity. Flat when out of position or below 200-SMA.
source:
# NVDA Donchian Breakout
# =============================================================================
# Long-only trend-following breakout strategy on NVDA.
#
# RULES:
# - Entry: Close > Prior bar's 20-day Donchian Upper Band (highest high)
# - Exit:  Close < Prior bar's 10-day Donchian Lower Band (lowest low)
# - Sizing: 100% of equity per trade (fully invested when in position)
# - Long-only — flat when out of position
# =============================================================================

# =============================================================================
# DATA SOURCE
# =============================================================================
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# =============================================================================
# INDICATORS
# =============================================================================

# 20-Day Donchian Channel for ENTRY (highest high over 20 days)
donchian_20 = donchian_channel(window=20)(high, low)
upper_band_20 = donchian_20.donchian_upper

# 10-Day Donchian Channel for EXIT (lowest low over 10 days)
donchian_10 = donchian_channel(window=10)(high, low)
lower_band_10 = donchian_10.donchian_lower

# Lag bands by 1 bar to avoid look-ahead bias
# Today's high/low contributes to today's channel — compare against PRIOR bar
upper_band_prior = upper_band_20 >> 1
lower_band_prior = lower_band_10 >> 1

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY / EXIT SIGNALS
# =============================================================================

# 200-day SMA trend filter
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# ENTRY: Close breaks above prior bar's 20-day high AND price is above 200-day SMA
entry_signal = (close > upper_band_prior) and (close > sma_200)

# EXIT: Close breaks below prior bar's 10-day low (trend weakening)
exit_signal = close < lower_band_prior

# Hold position from entry until exit fires
held = hold_until()(enter=entry_signal, exit=exit_signal)

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Long-only zone — flat when out of position
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Fully invested: 100% of equity per trade
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=100)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS
# =============================================================================

# Mark breakout entries
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Donchian Breakout Entry",
    icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="20d Upper Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, upper_band_prior, entry_signal)

# Mark exits (10-day Donchian breakdown)
event_marker(schema=EventMarkerSchema(
    title="Donchian Breakdown Exit",
    icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
    schemas=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="10d Lower Band", type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title="Signal", type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
    ]
))(close, lower_band_prior, exit_signal)
